display.title: Episode 13: The Lost Letter, Chapter 3 (Before Purim)
display.summary_short: The Lost Letter concludes: ten years late, Reb Leib delivers the Baal Shem Tov's letter and discovers its surprise. Plus Shema in Studio 604, listener calls and how to keep Purim.
display.summary_long: Aired the week before Purim 5742. After the opening and the Hakochainik march, Uncle Yossi recaps the story: Reb Leib did not ask his Rebbe, the Baal Shem Tov, for a brachah, lost everything, and ten years later found the sealed letter he had forgotten to deliver. A young Tzivos Hashem member recites the Shema in Studio 604, followed by a sponsor's dedication. In the final chapter, Reb Leib, now poor and shabby, travels to the mansion of his wealthy old friend Reb Shalom and insists on handing over the letter himself. Reb Shalom recognizes his Rebbe's seal, reads the letter in tears, and learns what the Baal Shem Tov wrote, with a surprise in the date at the top. Uncle Yossi draws the lesson about the power of a tzaddik's brachah. Then come a phone call with a young listener and his family, the mailbox, the rules of the Purim contest, and a clear guide to the four mitzvos of Purim: the Megillah, the Purim meal, mishloach manos and matanos la'evyonim. Note: the file continues with a full copy of the following week's Purim program (episode 14).
display.lesson: A brachah from a tzaddik is precious; ask for one, and carry out a tzaddik's instructions faithfully. Hashem gives special powers to those who serve Him with Torah and mitzvos.
